subject: Renewal addendum: blended-rate proposal for mid-contract expansion
thread_text:
From: Elena Torres <elena@novabio.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jake Morris <jake.morris@novabio.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal addendum: mid-contract expansion and billing question

Hi Marcus / Priyom,

Thanks again for the demo last week — NovaBio is ready to move forward with an additional 30% capacity on top of our current committed volume. Before we lock in PO timing I wanted to check a few items so I can brief procurement: 

- Can you provide a blended-rate option that covers our existing commit + the top-up for the remaining 6 months of the current term? Procurement prefers one invoice rather than multiple charges across the quarter.
- Is Redwood able to hold pricing for 30 days while we get the PO signed?
- We may need a short one-time credit or smoothing to align budget phasing from R&D to Ops — any flexibility there?

I attached our PO template (see nova_po_terms.pdf) with standard wording procurement expects. Happy to jump on a quick call if helpful.

Thanks,
Elena
Elena Torres
Head of ML Ops, NovaBio

----
Attachment: nova_po_terms.pdf (PDF, 82KB)

-----Original Message-----
(embedded in thread)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena@novabio.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jake Morris <jake.morris@novabio.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Renewal addendum: mid-contract expansion and billing question

Hi Elena — great to hear you want to expand. I sketched three pragmatic options below so procurement has choices; attached is a simple model (renewal_blend_model.xlsx) showing the math.

Option 1 — Blended-rate invoice (recommended for procurement simplicity):
- We calculate a blended per-token rate across current commit + incremental capacity for the remainder of the contract period.
- Discount ladder applied to the incremental volume: +20% = 10% discount on incremental slice; +50% = 15% discount.
- Single consolidated invoice; effective start date aligned to PO signing date.

Option 2 — Voucher/credit smoothing:
- One-time credit applied to the first invoice to offset ramp over the remainder of term (suggested: $15,000 onboarding credit).
- Incremental consumption billed at published rate; credit amortized on first invoice.

Option 3 — Staged invoicing with amortization:
- Purchase upfront for the top-up and amortize monthly across the remaining months to keep monthly cashflow flat.

A few operational notes: we can hold price for 30 days on the exact quantities you propose. Procurement wording on audit logs and data residency in your PO looks fine but I asked legal to quickly confirm the liability clause — should be a quick tick.

Next steps: tell me which option procurement prefers and whether you want us to issue a sample consolidated invoice. If you want blended-rate, I need a confirmation of the top-up % (e.g., +30% capacity) and the target start date.

Thanks,
Marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

----
Attachment: renewal_blend_model.xlsx (Excel, 28KB)

On Tue, 13 Jul 2027 09:15:00 -0700, Elena Torres <elena@novabio.com> wrote:

Marcus — thanks for the clear options. Procurement reviewed and replied with two priorities:

1) They want a single consolidated invoice and a guaranteed price hold for 30 days.
2) They prefer the blended-rate approach, but would like the discount applied as a flat blended percentage (simpler for their internal GL) rather than a multi-slice ladder.

Can Redwood provide a blended discount that converts the ladder into a single percent figure for the next 6 months? If so, please include the example invoice and the wording we should include in the PO to make sure accounts payable accepts it.

Also — we would like the start date to be the 1st of next month to align with our internal budget window.

Elena

----
On Wed, 14 Jul 2027 10:08:00 -0700, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com> wrote:

Forwarding to Rachel for quick approval on a one-time smoothing credit request from NovaBio. They are asking for the blended-rate and also a smoothing credit to help budget timing; I recommended a $15k credit to make the blended percent cleaner. Rachel, can we approve $15k one-time credit (non-recurring) to close the expansion this quarter?

Approve $15,000 one-time smoothing credit.
Please:
- Apply credit to first consolidated invoice.
- For simplicity for procurement, convert the ladder into a single blended discount of 12% for the first 6 months on the incremental volume, then revert to standard published rates after that period.

I want legal to add the PO-friendly wording Marcus suggested, but this is approved from a commercial perspective. Closing this will materially increase ARR and reduces churn risk.

Thanks,
Rachel
VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Summary / Next steps (action items):
- Marcus: produce a sample consolidated invoice with 12% blended discount on incremental capacity + apply $15k one-time credit; align effective start date to 2027-08-01 per Elena. (Action by: 2027-07-16)
- Priyom: confirm procurement-friendly PO wording with legal and send final doc to Elena. (Action by: 2027-07-16)
- Elena: confirm final top-up % (NovaBio indicated +30%) and sign PO within 30 days to lock pricing.

Attachments referenced above: renewal_blend_model.xlsx, nova_po_terms.pdf
